_comment: Live game servers. The defining feature of this environment is that a 'routine' restart is not routine when people are connected to it. Copy to your project root as .blastradius.json and gitignore it.

rules.why: Live server with players connected. Restarting drops everyone mid-session and can roll back unsaved inventories. Send an in-game countdown first.
The proxy is the single join address for the whole network. Taking it down disconnects every player on every backend server at once, not just one.
World or player data. There is no undo, and player inventories do not come back. Verify a backup exists and is restorable before touching this.
Sends a command straight into the live server console. /stop, /op, and /ban all take effect immediately with no confirmation.
Swapping a plugin jar under a running server usually does nothing until restart, and sometimes corrupts state. Stage it, then do a warned restart.
